value.value: P02.1 PETRA III total scattering uses a 2D detector, Fit2D integration and PDFgetX3 reduction. Measurements of deionized water in the same capillary type and at the same temperatures supply background. DiffPy CMI is used; PDFgui with LaB6 NIST 660b determines Qdamp.

value.value: D3 Zn clusters use the Debye approach with only scale fitted and literature-fixed ADPs. Crystalline D2 ZnO fits unit cell, scale and spheroid polar/equatorial size. Fullprof reciprocal refinement uses 16 variable-height background points, cell/zero/scale and Y00/Y40 size harmonics; other parameters are fixed. Values are in unavailable Tables S1-S2.
